offence_note: Historical sexual assault of five-year-old nephew, two occasions
sentence_quote: Having regard to the considerations I have reviewed, I sentence you to three years in prison.
note: Offender sexually abused himself as child; accepted as mitigating.

offence_note: Contempt of court for refusing to answer at murder trial
sentence_quote: I would grant leave to appeal the sentence, allow the appeal, and vary the sentence imposed from three years to two years.
note: Three and a half years pre-trial custody on acquitted murder charge considered as relevant information.

offence_note: Importing DMT and possession for trafficking DMT (ayahuasca)
sentence_quote: Mr. Adzich is sentenced to a conditional discharge on each count, with periods of 18 months’ probation for the importation followed by 18 months’ probation for the possession for the purposes of trafficking
note: Two consecutive 18-month probation periods; Elder comments on Indigenous history not about offender.

offence_note: Two counts possession for purpose of trafficking, street-level crack and heroin
sentence_quote: I am going to impose a sentence on you of seven months' incarceration with credit of 75 days for time spent in custody
note: Residential treatment only as directed by probation officer; victim surcharge waived.

offence_note: Incest with daughter and indecent assault of her friend
sentence_quote: He received a suspended sentence and 3 years probation, after serving fifty-three days pre-trial custody.
note: Crown leave to appeal sentence dismissed; Abella J.A. dissented.

offence_note: Aggravated assault, common assault, weapon dangerous purpose, resisting police
sentence_quote: A sentence of 4 years is the shortest period of incarceration that reflects his level of moral culpability in committing a serious act of violence with a weapon.
note: Four years consecutive to sentence already being served; 60 and 30 day terms concurrent; surcharge waived.

offence_note: Sexual assault (cupping breast); dangerous offender designation
sentence_quote: I am satisfied Mr. Ziegler's designation as a dangerous offender was reasonable, and would therefore dismiss the appeal.
note: Appeal of dangerous offender designation dismissed; indeterminate sentence stands.

offence_note: Welfare fraud of $5545 from the Province
sentence_quote: We permit leave to appeal, allow the appeal and vary the sentence to time served.
note: Nine months jail reduced to time served; probation with restitution stands.

offence_note: Impaired and dangerous driving causing death
sentence_quote: I would allow leave to appeal the sentence, but I would dismiss the appeal, except in relation to the offence of over 80.
note: Over 80 conviction conditionally stayed and concurrent sentence vacated; total sentence unchanged.
